name: Accept Ethereum Donations
author: dovsherman

sections.description:
Accept Ethereum Donations by digiDov is the easiest way for charities to accept Ethereum donations with INSTANT IRS-COMPLIANT TAX RECEIPTS automatically emailed to donors after each donation. 100% FREE to use with professional-grade compliance and security.

Key Features

  • FREE to use – No setup fees, monthly fees, or subscription costs
  • 100% Non-custodial – We NEVER hold your funds, they go directly to YOUR wallet
  • INSTANT IRS-COMPLIANT TAX RECEIPTS – Automatically emailed to donors immediately after donation
  • Hold crypto OR convert to dollars – Convert ETH to USD and transfer directly to your bank account
  • Professional dashboard – Real-time donation tracking and analytics
  • You keep 97% – Only 3% platform fee, competitive with traditional processors

How It Works

  1. Sign up FREE at digiDov.com – wallet created automatically
  2. Copy your donation link from your digiDov dashboard
  3. Paste the link in WordPress Admin → Accept Ethereum Donations settings
  4. Add donation button using [donate-ethereum] shortcode next to your PayPal/Visa buttons
  5. Start accepting crypto – donors automatically receive instant IRS-compliant tax receipts via email

Why Choose digiDov?

  • 🔒 100% Non-custodial – Your funds, your control. We can’t access them.
  • 📋 AUTOMATIC TAX RECEIPTS – Instant IRS-compliant receipts emailed to donors after each donation
  • 💵 Flexibility – Hold Ethereum or convert to dollars with instant bank transfer
  • ⛓️ On-chain Only – No credit cards, no traditional payment processing hassles
  • 🆓 Completely FREE – No setup fees, monthly fees, or subscription costs
  • 🏦 No Merchant Accounts – Skip the payment processor complexity

Perfect for Nonprofits

Churches & Religious Organizations
* Accept tithe and donations in Ethereum
* Automatic tax receipts for all donors
* No technical knowledge required

Charities & Foundations
* Reach younger, tech-savvy donors
* Reduce processing fees (3% vs 5-10% traditional)
* Instant global donations with no currency conversion

501c3 Organizations
* IRS-compliant receipts automatically generated
* Convert Ethereum to USD and transfer directly to your bank account
* Meets all nonprofit reporting requirements
* Donors get instant tax-deductible documentation

Educational Institutions
* Accept alumni donations in cryptocurrency
* Modern payment option for student fundraising
* Complete donation tracking and reporting

Installation

  1. Install Plugin: Upload and activate through WordPress admin
  2. Sign Up FREE: Create account at digiDov.com
  3. Get Your Link: Copy donation link from digiDov dashboard
  4. Configure Plugin: Paste link in WordPress → Accept Ethereum Donations settings
  5. Add Button: Use [donate-ethereum] shortcode anywhere on your site
  6. Start Receiving: Donors get instant tax receipts, you get crypto donations!

Shortcode Usage

  • [donate-ethereum] – Displays the Ethereum donation button
  • Works in posts, pages, widgets, sidebars – anywhere shortcodes are supported
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design

Support

Visit digiDov.com for support and to create your FREE account.

Accept Ethereum donations like cash – hold it or convert to dollars instantly.
sections.faq:
How much does it cost to use this plugin?

Completely FREE! The plugin has no setup fees, monthly fees, or subscription costs. digiDov only takes a 3% platform fee from donations (you keep 97%). This is competitive with traditional payment processors like PayPal or Stripe.

Do you hold my cryptocurrency?

No, never! We are 100% non-custodial. Your funds go directly to YOUR wallet. digiDov cannot access, hold, or control your funds at any time.

Do donors get tax receipts?

Yes, instantly! Every donor automatically receives an IRS-compliant tax receipt via email immediately after their donation. This is fully automated.

Can I convert Ethereum to dollars?

Yes! Through the digiDov dashboard, you can instantly convert your Ethereum donations to USD and transfer the funds directly to your organization’s bank account. Perfect for nonprofits that need operating funds in traditional currency.

How do I add the donation button to my site?

Simply use the [donate-ethereum] shortcode anywhere on your WordPress site – in posts, pages, widgets, or anywhere shortcodes are supported.

Is this secure?

Extremely secure! All transactions happen on the blockchain. We never touch your funds, and all donations are processed through secure smart contracts.

Do I need technical knowledge to use this?

No! Simply sign up at digiDov.com, copy your donation link, paste it in the WordPress settings, and add the shortcode. That’s it!

What cryptocurrencies are supported?

Currently we support Ethereum donations. More cryptocurrencies may be added in future updates.

How quickly do I receive donations?

Instantly! Donations go directly to your wallet on the blockchain. No waiting periods or processing delays.

Can I track my donations?

Yes! The digiDov dashboard provides real-time donation tracking and analytics for all your campaigns.
